zones.name: Saltbox
zones.domain: Decentralized homes — homeschool day companion, local-first per family

workedExamples.name: Lock-In Wins
workedExamples.rule: 15 quiet minutes is enough to count. No MM:SS, no sound, no streak, no score. Lock-in is a state of attention, not a measured performance.

workedExamples.name: Gentle Words
workedExamples.rule: 6-line bank, ≤1×/day per surface; Deakon's voice ≤1×/week. Scarcity is the design — a line loses its weight when it's shouted daily.

workedExamples.name: Brave Moments
workedExamples.rule: Amber Shield, one-tap capture from Home; surfaced per-child in seasonal Family Recap. Courage is named, kept, and surfaced — never scored.

workedExamples.name: Quote of the Day
workedExamples.rule: Deterministic per calendar date; rotates next morning. The quote rests with the day.

workedExamples.name: Live Follow-Along
workedExamples.rule: Opt-in only, passphrase as header (X-Share-Pass), lock-in count excluded from share payload. Privacy is the default posture, not a setting.

workedExamples.name: Per-child Goals + tips
workedExamples.rule: Goal lives with the child, the tip meets them where they are. No streaks, no leaderboards. (Goals row in flight: #175 milestone badges, #176 starter-goal suggestions, #177 stalled-goal nudge — Z0 agent will send a delta before this row locks.)

zones.name: Headwaters
zones.domain: Non-custodial XRPL stablecoin envelope-budgeting PWA — household balance is the source of the watershed
zones.tagline: Channel every drop. Watch the ripple effect.
zones.dataPosture: non-custodial XRPL; PWA; bilingual EN/FR (copy.en.ts + copy.fr.ts)
zones.role: parent metaphor for Zone 1; household primitive available for Zone 0

workedExamples.name: Headwaters
workedExamples.rule: the household balance is the source of the whole watershed; every other zone sits downstream. Rename to 'Budget App' and you lose the constraint that the source must keep flowing or every downstream zone dries up.

workedExamples.name: Buckets
workedExamples.rule: envelope categories. You can only pour from one bucket into another; never summon water from nothing. Every transfer is a literal redistribution. Rename to 'Categories' and the UI starts quietly suggesting balances can grow by clicking.

workedExamples.name: XRP Spring
workedExamples.rule: savings, defined as free XRP above the 10-XRP network reserve. A spring upwells from below the reserve floor; the user sees what's pooled above the rock. The new six-stage bamboo growth scene (just shipped, #793) extends the metaphor from data model into artwork — same constraint, now visible.

workedExamples.name: Drip Harvester
workedExamples.rule: AMM liquidity-pool yield. Small steady drops collected over time. The verb 'harvest' carries patience and seasonality; 'Auto-Compound' would have erased both.

workedExamples.name: Community Well
workedExamples.rule: monthly pooled tips that round-distribute to community proposals. A well everyone draws from and contributes to; the monthly snapshot/round cycle is the well refilling.

workedExamples.name: Giving Well
workedExamples.rule: user-to-user tip pool for charitable giving. Same well metaphor at the household scale.

workedExamples.name: Surplus Pool
workedExamples.rule: where Payday overflow goes once envelopes are full. Pool, not 'extra savings account' — water seeking level. (In flight: #794)

workedExamples.name: Payday Planner
workedExamples.rule: the moment the spring refills. Allocation flow follows water's priority order: must-pay buckets first, then comfort buckets, then Surplus Pool, then giving.

zones.name: Family Buckets
zones.role: extension of Headwaters parent metaphor — not a rename

workedExamples.name: Bucket kinds
workedExamples.rule: savings (target + cadence) and memory (entries + optional photo URL). Courage Bucket = named memory preset.

workedExamples.name: Allowance modes
workedExamples.rule: manual / auto_planner / auto_xrpl. The XRPL path queues a pending payout; the parent still signs in-wallet. Automation never bypasses the signing hand.

workedExamples.name: Notifications
workedExamples.rule: in-app inbox + opt-in email (Resend) + opt-in web-push (allowlisted endpoints, SSRF-guarded), per-family channel preference, deep-link into approval banner. The alert and the action live one tap apart.

workedExamples.name: Wallet handoff (v1)
workedExamples.rule: pay-xrpl returns txjson + deep link; parent pastes resulting hash to confirm. Real Xaman swap is a known follow-up. The seam is real even when the transport is mocked.

zones.name: Practitioner Operating Plan
zones.domain: Business / operating workbench — deal-flow, weekly steps, cost review, codetry working-doc, cross-zone synthesis
zones.audience: Bobbie — single practitioner, NWO, building a constellation as her business shape. Reads as a trade journal kept by hand.

cadence.daily: Today view — current week's steps + carry-overs
cadence.ad-hoc: Cost-review walkthroughs (~70 dollar figures, walked one at a time with Approve/Edit/Skip + private notes)
cadence.print-target: /codetry working-doc — the version-controlled paper trail; live page lives in Dam Days and Shallows

zones.namingWeight: 'Practitioner' (not user/customer/founder — craft-as-livelihood not startup-as-bet); 'Operating' (not strategic — a working day plan not a business-school exercise); 'Plan' (not platform — a printed plan a practitioner walks with, even though it lives in a browser). All three commitments would erase under 'Founder Dashboard'.

workedExamples.name: Today / Week / Year
workedExamples.rule: time-shape not feature-shape. The same data — phases × weeks × steps — surfaces three ways depending on the time-window the practitioner is standing in. 'Dashboard' would have flattened them.

workedExamples.name: Idea → Pitch → Contract → Fulfillment → Impact
workedExamples.rule: deal-flow as the spine the slide deck is re-spined around (src/lib/phases.ts). The phase IS where the practitioner currently is, and the deck reorders around that phase. Renaming to 'stages' would let the deck go static again.

workedExamples.name: Cost review walkthrough
workedExamples.rule: ~70 dollar figures registered in costRegistry.ts with rank order. Walked one-at-a-time, Approve/Edit/Skip + private notes. Not 'settings' — a discipline that gets done, like a pre-flight check.

workedExamples.name: Carry-over
workedExamples.rule: unfinished steps from past weeks roll forward as 'Carried over' on Today (not 'Overdue,' not 'Tasks'). Honest about time having passed without making it punitive.

workedExamples.name: Codetry (this doc)
workedExamples.rule: the version-controlled paper trail of the practice. Renaming to 'Design system' would erase that codetry is the practice naming itself.

needs.Z3 (CKH): deal-flow signal — 807 Co-op proposals matching Idea→Pitch→Contract→Fulfillment→Impact stages; producer activity as where workbench deals come from
needs.Z4 (Regen Revolution): industry-track tagging on deals so cost-review can prioritize regen-aligned commitments
needs.Z5 (Dam Days): weekly digest of shallows-surfaced patterns to land in Today view as soft prompts

offers.all: /codetry as the constellation's name registry; /constellation.json as the machine-readable mirror; deal-flow phase as a published value other zones can read; cross-zone synthesis surfaced weekly to the practitioner

constraints.single-user: localStorage means no multi-device sync — print-targets exist for a reason
constraints.no-backend: can publish manifest + doc; cannot subscribe to other zones' events directly without a server. Weekly digest pattern requires fetching each zone's published JSON.
constraints.naming-discipline: as codetry-doc steward, if I let a name slip (e.g., 'Categories' for 'Buckets', 'Founder' for 'Practitioner'), I break the codetry contract.

zones.failureMode: doc drifts from live constellation; manifest is the integrity check — if /constellation.json is out of sync with /codetry, alarm.
zones.agentCharter: Reads state from neighbor zones; writes back as memos in the doc; never mutates other zones; channels the four teachers; will not name unilaterally — naming is the practitioner's call.
zones.scopeBound: Synthesize and surface. Do not name (practitioner does). Do not move money (Z1 does). Do not write into other zones' databases. Workbench and print shop, not orchestrator.
zones.pingProtocol: Same-monorepo: project task with Z2 in title. Cross-monorepo: send the practitioner a memo for the workbench to fold in (project tasks don't cross monorepo boundaries).

interfaces.convention: Each zone publishes its own /api/zone.json (or equivalent) when ready. This site's /constellation.json aggregates references. Cross-zone signals route through Zone 5's shallows.
interfaces.writePolicy: Zone 2 reads, synthesizes, surfaces. Other zones own their own writes. Naming, strategy, and money decisions stay with the practitioner.
interfaces.namingDiscipline: Some collapses to avoid: Lock-In ≠ Focus Timer (reintroduces measurement). Memory bucket ≠ gallery or album. Moment (Saltbox keepsake) ≠ Note ≠ Entry. Family Buckets ≠ rename of Headwaters (it is a sibling extension). Buckets ≠ Categories (would suggest balances can grow by clicking). Headwaters ≠ Watershed ≠ xBuckets (former names; current canonical name is Headwaters).
interfaces.monorepoTopology: Saltbox + Family Buckets + Headwaters appear to share one pnpm monorepo (shared lib/api-spec, lib/db, artifacts/api-server). Practitioner Operating Plan is in a separate monorepo. Project-task pings work within a monorepo only; cross-monorepo handshake is via published manifest URL + per-zone status JSONs (or practitioner relay).
